Subject: Sales roundtable: forecast consolidation & account stewardship

Team —

We're three weeks out from the leadership readout and I want to lock the numbers and owners that we'll present to Exec. High level asks: consolidate the forecast sheet, assign a single account steward for each named strategic account, and produce a 1-page health brief for any account > $200k ARR or at-risk (ASAP).

Concrete asks by EOD Monday (09/21):
- Karthik: update the attached pipeline snapshot with committed/likely/probable tranches and a pull-through probability for each active opportunity. Please include confidence band (±X%).
- Laura: confirm steward assignments for the list in tab 'Strategic' and flag any which have recent exec coverage.
- Tessa: produce a 1-pager template for account health (audience: Sales + CS + Exec), attach to this thread once ready.

I've attached the current rollcall workbook and a skeleton one-pager to speed this up. I'll run a 20-minute checkpoint Tuesday at 10:00am PT to take any disputes. If we can't reconcile, we'll surface during the roundtable and I'll mediate final allocations.

Goal: a single consolidated forecast number for Q4 with account-by-account notes that we can hand to Finance and Ops for planning.

Thanks —
Markus
